plugins.name: compose-preview
plugins.description: Render and review your Compose previews locally, and browse the hosted Material 3 and Wear catalogs and UI Builder.

interface.longDescription: Iterate on local Compose previews with live rendering, accessibility checks, catalog design guidelines and shared review evidence, with the hosted component catalogs and UI Builder alongside.
defaultPrompt: Render and review the Compose previews in this project.

compose_preview_token.title: Compose Preview token
compose_preview_token.description: Optional access token for the hosted preview.coo.ee service. Leave it blank to use the service's interactive access grant.

plugins.name: compose-catalogs
plugins.description: Discover Compose components, inspect properties, and render catalog variants, with no local toolchain.

interface.shortDescription: Discover and render Compose component catalogs.
interface.longDescription: Discover Compose components, render catalog variants, and review UI Builder designs against catalog guidelines through Compose Preview.
defaultPrompt: Show the available Compose component catalogs.
Review this UI Builder design against its catalog design guidelines.

compose_preview_token.title: Compose Preview token

plugins.name: compose-review
plugins.description: Review Compose UI pull requests by rendering base and head, and set up CI that posts before/after previews.

interface.shortDescription: Review Compose UI pull requests and set up preview CI.
interface.longDescription: Review Compose UI pull requests by rendering base and head and checking catalog design guidelines, and set up GitHub Actions CI that posts before/after previews on pull requests. Pairs with the compose-preview plugin.
defaultPrompt: Review the Compose UI changes in this pull request.
Set up CI that posts before/after Compose previews on pull requests.

plugins.name: pr-watch
plugins.description: Tell the agent about new review comments, CI failures and merge conflicts on its pull requests whenever it stops.

interface.shortDescription: Hear about pull request reviews, CI failures and conflicts at stop points.
interface.longDescription: Watches the open pull requests for the checkout's branch. When the agent stops, or a session starts or resumes, it reports new review comments, failed checks and merge conflicts so the agent keeps driving the pull request until it is done.
defaultPrompt: Watch the pull request for this branch and handle review comments and CI failures.
